name: command-search
title: Command Search
description: The search palette's frame, results first — one row of scope chips with a More menu (and Include archived), results up to min(60dvh, 520px), an in-flight state that dims stale results under an input progress bar, Recent · Create · Places start sections, and a preview pane from 1280px.

meta.whenToUse: App-wide search behind ⌘K: scopes, results from your search call (with useAsyncSearch), recents and places when empty.
meta.whenNotToUse: A command menu of actions only (Command), or filtering one list in place (ListToolbar's search).
